correctness.rationale: PASS: Independent symbolic reconstruction from beta moments of F_t(s) and log coefficients c1,c2,c3 gives the exact central formula, transverse derivatives (-24/7 and (32sqrt61-244)/45) and small-circle slope (56sqrt61-427)/270. For fixed t, the binomial-difference kernel yields g~(t+2)/(1-s)^2 and curvature limit -2/(t+2); continuity proves existence but NOT uniqueness for general t. Integer cases 0..4 were independently recomputed as rational curvatures. For t=4, N(s) has coefficient sign pattern +,-,...,-,+, N(0)>0>N(1) and reciprocity s^12 N(1/s)=N(s), proving exactly one simple interior root, without relying on floating root-finding. All claims are within the stated norms/domain.

final_claim: For genuine Euclidean-distance disk weights (1-|z|)^t, t>-1, normalized central Bergman curvature equals 4(t^2+t-15)/[5(t+3)(t+4)], changes sign at (sqrt(61)-1)/2; for every higher real t at least one zero-curvature circle, near onset one small branch with stated slope; integer t=0..3 all negative, t=4 exactly one positive core with algebraic squared radius 0.0175975033598718... .
